<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A dish as a card: picture, optional badge, category, name, portion/weight, summary, price and an order button.
  No rating. Axes: layout (vertical, horizontal), media (image, none), density, action (button, none). Records
  map from Codex kind `dish`.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { DishLabels } from "./dish-card.types";
import type { Dish } from "./dish-showcase.types";

export type DishCardProps = {
  dish: Dish;
  labels: DishLabels;
  layout?: "vertical" | "horizontal";
  media?: "image" | "none";
  prices?: "show" | "hide";
  action?: "button" | "none";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Badge from "../compose/Badge.vue";
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Button from "../compose/Button.vue";
import CardContent from "../compose/CardContent.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import Link from "../compose/Link.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import { cn, fmtMoney, urlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  dish,
  labels,
  layout = "vertical",
  media = "image",
  prices = "show",
  action = "button",
  density = "default",
} = defineProps<DishCardProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ add: [id: string] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="article"
    :class="cn(
      'flex flex-col gap-8 bg-card p-6 text-card-foreground inset-ring inset-ring-border rounded',
      'h-full gap-4 overflow-hidden',
      (((layout as string) === 'horizontal') ? 'flex flex-col sm:flex-row' : 'flex flex-col')
    )"
    data-slot="card"
    :data-layout="layout"
  >
    <Box
      v-if="((media as string) === 'image')"
      :class="cn('relative shrink-0', (((layout as string) === 'horizontal') ? 'sm:w-48' : ''))"
    >
      <MediaFrame :alt="dish.name" ratio="4/3" class="h-full" />
      <Badge v-if="dish.badge" variant="default" size="default" class="absolute left-4 top-4">
        {{ dish.badge }}
      </Badge>
    </Box>
    <CardContent class="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-2">
      <Group gap="2" align="center" class="flex-wrap">
        <Text size="xs" class="uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground" data-slot="category">
          {{ dish.tag }}
        </Text>
        <template v-if="((media as string) === 'none')">
          <Badge v-if="dish.badge" variant="secondary" size="sm">
            {{ dish.badge }}
          </Badge>
        </template>
      </Group>
      <Title :as="3" size="base" weight="bold">
        <Link v-if="dish.href" :href="urlOf(dish.href)" variant="default" data-slot="open">
          {{ dish.name }}
        </Link>
        <template v-else>
          {{ dish.name }}
        </template>
      </Title>
      <Text v-if="dish.weight" size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground" data-slot="portion">
        {{ dish.weight }}
      </Text>
      <Text v-if="((density as string) === 'default')" size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
        {{ dish.summary }}
      </Text>
      <Group gap="4" justify="between" class="mt-auto pt-2">
        <Text v-if="((prices as string) === 'show')" size="xl" weight="bold" data-slot="price">
          {{ fmtMoney(dish.price, dish.currency) }}
        </Text>
        <Button
          v-if="((action as string) === 'button')"
          variant="default"
          size="sm"
          type="button"
          @click="() => emit('add', dish.id)"
        >
          {{ labels.add }}
        </Button>
      </Group>
    </CardContent>
  </Block>
</template>
